page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 4 vCPUs, operating at a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, which ensures dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be attached externally. It contains no graphics processing units and does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m2.medium is positioned as a memory-optimized resource. This density profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints relative to compute capacity, such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, and lightweight data processing pipelines.
